housing.summary: LivingCost reports an average monthly rent of EUR 632.91 for a one-bedroom apartment in Catania city centre; a deposit norm and a main local rental portal were not grounded.

banking.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo says online account opening requires a current identity document and a current codice fiscale or health card.
required_docs: Current identity card, driving licence, or passport
Current codice fiscale or health card

schools.summary: The Catania directory lists one international school using a bespoke curriculum taught in German and Italian.

legal_admin.summary: Foreign citizens changing residence to Catania must register with the municipal Anagrafe within 60 days; foreign-resident changes are handled through Centro Direzionale San Leone, PEC, or post.
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit a residence-change declaration to the Comune di Catania Anagrafe within 60 days of moving.

tax_finance.summary: A first Italian tax identification number requires an in-person appointment; eligible applicants apply through the Revenue Agency, while specified non-EU cases are handled by the immigration desk or police headquarters.

transport.summary: AMTS identifies the metropolitan TPL as an integrated AMTS bus and FCE metro network and prices the monthly integrated pass at EUR 35; driving-licence exchange and healthcare registration were not grounded in this service record.
transport.network_name: TPL Metropolitano (AMTS bus and FCE metro)
